notablePrerequisites:

description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn by at least {4}.
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {B} due to Rowan's ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token and returning Lab Rats to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Rat, adding {B}.
Repeat from step 2.
